summary_en: MTI Ltd. updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management targets. The company provided revised guidance on capital efficiency and shareholder return metrics based on progress since the October 2025 announcement.
title_en: Update on Initiatives for Realizing Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On September 9, 2026, MTI Ltd. announced an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management strategy, which was originally disclosed on October 17, 2025. The specific targets, metrics, and financial conditions are presented in the attached materials. The update reflects the company's progress and any adjustments made since the initial announcement in October 2025. The disclosure confirms the company's ongoing commitment to capital efficiency and stock price awareness in its management decisions.
